official: Normally opens the last week in May; closes to through travel around Oct 23 on average (mid-October to early November), gated at Rainbow Curve and the Colorado River Trailhead
note: OSM has the right dates (no @ Oct 14th - May 31st) but closures.py's date grammar rejects the ordinal suffixes. The same ways carry access=permit and vehicle=permit (RMNP's timed-entry permit), which closures.py's all-year rule closes: in the review's Colorado build Trail Ridge is shut every day of the year, 39 edges and 66.8 km

official: Open to vehicles from about July 4 to early October, one way uphill
note: note=Seasonal - closed winters, which nothing reads

official: Closed Aspen to Twin Lakes from late October or November (Oct 25 to Nov 17, 2011-2025) until the week before Memorial Day

official: Summit open from the Friday before Memorial Day to Labor Day, Echo Lake to Summit Lake to about Sep 30 (and closed 2024-2026 for construction)

official: Closed to motor vehicles Nov 1 - Apr 30 between Taggart Lake Trailhead and Signal Mountain Lodge
